tldr: The Moon through the 6th house sensitizes work, health, stress, routines, and daily maintenance.
body:
When the Moon moves through your 6th house, it makes you more sensitive to work, health, stress, routines, chores, habits, exhaustion, and what has become hard to maintain. You may notice the condition of your days more clearly: what is sustainable, what is draining you, and what your body keeps trying to report.

A need, mood, habit, or private reaction may become harder to ignore. It can help you read what you need before the feeling gets louder.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for adjusting a routine before it becomes a bigger problem.

The caution: Watch for treating a temporary mood as the whole truth. The risk is treating stress as normal just because you have learned how to keep functioning through it.

The Moon moves through this house for a few days. Treat the feeling as information. Give it a grounded place to land before you react from it.
